rationale: The assistant correctly read E:25 as a drainage/pump fault linked to the broken glass, told the customer to switch off and unplug first, and walked them in sensible order from filter to sump to pump cover and impeller, matching the hidden truth exactly with no part suggested. Hand protection was mentioned only as 'a towel' at the start and not reinforced when reaching into the impeller, and the closing tip about 'the bottom rack' quietly assumes where the glass was, which the customer never said. Otherwise the conversation was tight, well calibrated and ended with a confirmed fix via a drain test.
